description: This file contains asynchronous functions to create and verify database views related to spend logs, tokens, and user data in the LiteLLM project.

methods.name: create_missing_views
methods.description: Creates various database views if they do not already exist, including views for verification tokens, global spend, spend logs, and user data.

methods.name: should_create_missing_views
methods.description: Determines if views should be created on first startup based on the row count of the SpendLogs table.
